info.name: Urban Observatory API: Urban Sciences Building Entity Timeseries API
Request a single timeseries by its unique ID

params.name: id
params.description: Timeseries ID to retrieve description and latest observed value for.

items.docs: A single timeseries and its current value will be returned, if recent, provided a valid ID is supplied and permissions permit.

info.name: Request historic data from a timeseries by its unique ID and a date range

params.name: id
params.description: Timeseries ID to retrieve historic data for.

params.name: startTime
params.description: Start period for the historic data to be retrieved, inclusive.

params.name: endTime
params.description: End period for the historic data to be retrieved, inclusive.

params.name: outputAs
params.description: Output format for the data, although JSON is always recommended and CSV outputs are computed from JSON.

items.docs: A date range may be specified to obtain historic readings from a timeseries, or the last 24 hours will be provided by default.
